messages:
mark-sales: Urgent - client HelixHealth POC on staging hit steady 429s during a mixed workflow: bulk vector import + live Q&A demo. Seeing ~1.2k 429s in 8m. Demo in 50m, anyone who can triage? :grimacing:
eva-eng: I'm awake. Can you paste one of the 429 bodies + request_id and which routes were failing?
mark-sales: From support: req_id=hh-9982, failing_routes=[/v1/embeddings,/v1/rerank], status=429, body:{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":0.7}
liam-sre: Pulling quota logs for tenant=helix-poc. Observed tenant_token_budget drop-off coinciding with a bulk import job (parallelism=12). Per-route caps: embeddings=220r/min, rerank=60r/min. Shared tenant limits hit -> token accounting caused 429s across both routes.
rosa-support: Customer confirms they kicked off an import of ~80k docs at t=3023456400 and the PM was doing live QA (rerank calls) using same key.
eva-eng: Same-key background job causing noisy-neighbor effects. Short fixes: (A) temporary per-route bump for rerank + embeddings, (B) issue a short reservation for interactive rerank route, or (C) disable concurrent import workers.
mark-sales: They prefer a quick reservation for rerank for 1h so the demo won't be blocked. Can we carve that now?
liam-sre: Yes. Internal admin API snippet we use: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/helix-poc/quotas \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/rerank","rate":180,"burst":600,"reservation":true,"expires_in":"1h"}'
```
Applying ... change_id=chg_hh_901.
ops-bot: quota-service:apply chg_hh_901 status=rolled_out regions=[us-east-1,eu-west-1]
rosa-support: Sending to customer now. They want a one-paragraph note for security saying whether this was a bug.
eva-eng: Draft for security: "This is expected platform behavior. The quota system enforces per-route and tenant token budgets. Running a high-concurrency bulk import with the same API key consumed the shared tenant budget, causing concurrent interactive requests to receive 429 responses. Recommended mitigations: use separate API keys for bulk/background jobs, add per-route reservations for interactive endpoints, or provision Dedicated capacity for sustained throughput."
mark-sales: Nice. Also they asked for cost impact of the 1h reservation if fully used.
liam-sre: Quick upper-bound: 180 req/min * avg 650 tokens * 60 min = ~7.02M tokens. At demo pricing that's roughly $80 (conservative). If they only use it intermittently cost will be much lower.
eva-eng: Also pulled logs to provide a snapshot they requested: per-route token debits, top offending request_ids, and a short recommendation list (attach later).
rosa-support: Customer also asked whether we can automate detection and suggest quotas in the Console for future trials.
eva-eng: We already have Optimize heuristics but I'll add a quick checklist to the runbook: detect sustained per-route token drain > threshold -> recommend separate API key or auto-reserve interactive route.
mark-sales: Please send the runbook + the one-paragraph and change_id to HelixHealth now. I'll schedule a 15-min post-demo tech sync to walk through long-term fixes. Thanks team :rocket:
